name: 93535 · Lancaster, CA
findings: ZIP 93535 (Lancaster) has 165 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93535 (Lancaster) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 93535 (Lancaster) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
